Callout.Name: Drone Over Protected Land
Callout.Message: Drone flown over a protected area.
Callout.Advisory: Operator on a ridge, drone airborne.

Script.Line: It is over the nesting area. That is closed this month.
It has been up twenty minutes and it is filming the whole valley.
The operator is somewhere by the car park. That is where they always are.

Lines.Approach: It is over ground it should not be, and the operator is up there flying it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
